test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the given figure, AB is parallel to CD. What is the value (in degrees) of x?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a5498c17cf57ee34dfff9144216b495ecf863f8ec79332db483a21a53cb11b.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Draw a parallel line through point E to AB and CD.

The angle x is the sum of the supplements of the given angles.

Upper part of x = 180° − 100° = 80°

Lower part of x = 180° − 140° = 40°

x = 80° + 40° = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** AB || CD, ∠BAE = 100°, ∠ECD = 140°

**Formula Used:** Sum of co-interior angles between two parallel lines = 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f866363400d86f46ce845c8f1beae65eca21a6a0d6154608e7b02ed99fb81c04.png] 

⇒ Construct a line EF parallel to AB and CD passing through E.

⇒ AB || EF ∴ ∠BAE + ∠AEF = 180° (Co-interior angles)

⇒ 100° + ∠AEF = 180° ⇒ ∠AEF = 80°

⇒ CD || EF ∴ ∠ECD + ∠CEF = 180° (Co-interior angles)

⇒ 140° + ∠CEF = 180° ⇒ ∠CEF = 40°

⇒ x = ∠AEF + ∠CEF

⇒ x = 80° + 40° = 120°

**∴ The correct answer is 120°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Co-interior Angles

When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, the sum of the interior angles on the same side is always 180°.

Alternate Interior Angles

When a transversal intersects two parallel lines, the alternate interior angles formed are always equal.

Sum of Interior Angles

For a closed polygon with n sides, the sum of all interior angles is given by (n − 2) × 180°.
